mapper.sql: s.id, s.student_code, s.student_name, s.phone, s.password, s.graduation_session, s.school, s.education, s.study_mode, s.class_id, case when c.id is null then null else concat(c.class_term, '期') end as class_name, s.product_id, p.product_name, s.join_time, s.created_at, s.updated_at
mapper.update: update edu_student set student_code = #{studentCode}, student_name = #{studentName}, phone = #{phone}, password = #{password}, graduation_session = #{graduationSession}, school = #{school}, education = #{education}, study_mode = #{studyMode}, class_id = #{classId}, product_id = #{productId}, join_time = #{joinTime}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select from edu_student s left join edu_class c on c.id = s.class_id left join sale_product p on p.id = s.product_id where s.id = #{id}
